cat_objects_to_affection_nov08.title: Eight Real Moments in a Cat's Day
cat_objects_to_affection_nov08.script: A curious cat finds a paper bag and peers inside, turning a simple object into a hiding place. Another kitten has a quieter scene, resting indoors rather than joining the chase. Outside, a black cat walks steadily, while a separate cat carefully cleans its fur. In two different homes, one cat paws at a cotton bud and two others play together. A cat in Taiwan rolls and stretches on the floor, showing another kind of movement. Finally, a cat outdoors enjoys a person's gentle touch, ending with a calm moment.
cat_objects_to_affection_nov08.caption: FROM A PAPER BAG TO A GENTLE PAT. Different cats and their everyday behavior, filmed in separate real places. #WildVox #Cats #CatBehavior

goat_steps_meals_and_rest_nov08.title: From First Steps to the Hillside
goat_steps_meals_and_rest_nov08.script: Young goat kids stay near an adult, taking cautious steps across familiar ground. Far away, a managed hillside herd spreads across the grass to graze. Other goats move over rocks, where each careful step keeps the group going. Two separate recordings contrast goats feeding on hay with another resting in open grass. In a pen, movement slows as goats pause and groom, a different part of their day. A lone goat stands outside in the grass, closing this look at different daily routines.
goat_steps_meals_and_rest_nov08.caption: FIRST STEPS, HILLSIDES, AND QUIET GOAT MOMENTS. Separately filmed, genuine goat footage. #WildVox #Goats #AnimalBehavior

horse_shore_to_woodland_nov08.title: A Horse's Quiet Route Through Nature
horse_shore_to_woodland_nov08.script: At the water's edge, a pale horse lowers its head to drink, staying close to the shore. Another horse grazes on the bank, choosing grass while water remains nearby. Elsewhere, a small group shifts across open shore ground and pauses together. On separate farms, one horse grazes in a field, while another stands beside a person. Other herds explore grassy wetland edges, moving between patches of open ground. A white horse feeds among trees, ending this journey with a quieter scene.
horse_shore_to_woodland_nov08.caption: FROM WATER TO WOODLAND. Separate real horse scenes show drinking, grazing and moving across open ground. #WildVox #Horses #Nature

blackbird_from_worm_to_song_nov08.title: A Blackbird's Day From Ground to Song
blackbird_from_worm_to_song_nov08.script: A common blackbird pauses with food in its beak, revealing what it found in a garden. In another park, a blackbird stays close to stones and low vegetation. Across different afternoons, the birds move between leaves and open ground, checking each patch. Searching near grass can bring worms and insects within reach, even on busy days. Then the soundtrack changes: a blackbird sings from a perch before dawn. Later, other blackbirds return to the city's ground-level spaces, where their search continues.
blackbird_from_worm_to_song_nov08.caption: FROM A GARDEN SEARCH TO A DAWN SONG. Different real common blackbirds in separate settings. #WildVox #Blackbird #Birdwatching

mallard_waterside_and_young_nov08.title: Mallards Along the Water's Edge
mallard_waterside_and_young_nov08.script: Several mallards glide together on a park pond, cutting small ripples through the surface. Another group follows the edge of a city waterway, passing slowly through the current. Winter recordings show the ducks changing direction and approaching different sections of shore. At another pond, their broad bills hover near the water as they investigate the bank. Some ducks keep paddling through the cold water, while others drift a little farther. Two separate recordings show young ducks near adults, reminding us how early they begin to swim.
mallard_waterside_and_young_nov08.caption: MALLARDS ON THE MOVE. Genuine separately filmed park, river and duckling moments. #WildVox #Mallard #Wildlife
